name: Exp_AFStar
summary: Exp_AFStar is an Expert Advisor that implements a trend-following strategy using the AFStar signal system. It identifies trend direction through its proprietary indicator logic and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels while applying trailing stop functionality to protect gains.
summary_zh: Exp_AFStar是一个基于AFStar信号系统的趋势跟踪专家顾问。它通过专有指标逻辑识别趋势方向，并在趋势方向上开仓交易。该EA通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理仓位，同时应用移动止损功能来保护利润。
strategy_analysis: Exp_AFStar采用趋势跟踪策略，利用AFStar指标判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为当AFStar指标发出趋势信号时，在趋势方向上开仓做多或做空。出场条件包括达到预设的止盈目标、触发止损或指标发出反向信号时平仓。仓位管理方面，支持固定手数交易，可能包含基于账户资金的动态仓位计算。资金管理通过止损设置和移动止损来控制每笔交易的风险敞口。该策略适合在趋势明显的市场中运行，但在震荡行情中可能产生较多虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: Exp_AFStar employs a trend-following strategy that utilizes the AFStar indicator to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions are triggered when the AFStar indicator generates a trend signal, opening long or short positions in the direction of the prevailing trend. Exit conditions include reaching preset take profit targets, hitting stop loss levels, or closing positions when the indicator issues a reversal signal. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may include dynamic position calculation based on account equity. Money management controls risk exposure on each trade through stop loss settings and trailing stop functionality. The strategy performs well in strongly trending markets but may generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy conditions.
pros: 趋势跟踪策略在明显趋势市场中表现良好，能捕捉大波段利润
具有止损和移动止损功能，有效控制单笔交易风险
系统化交易逻辑清晰，参数可配置性高，便于优化调整
pros_en: Trend-following strategy captures large trend moves effectively in directional markets
Built-in stop loss and trailing stop functionality provides solid per-trade risk control
Clear systematic trading logic with configurable parameters allows for easy optimization and adjustment
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单一指标判断趋势方向可靠性有限
未见到专门的点差过滤或交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
cons_en: Trend-following strategies are prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, relying on a single indicator reduces trend direction reliability
No apparent spread filter or trading session filter, potentially opening positions under unfavorable conditions
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势确认，例如在H4确认趋势方向后在H1入场
添加震荡市场过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在横盘时减少交易频率
引入动态仓位管理，根据ATR调整止损距离和仓位大小
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation, e.g., confirm trend on H4 before entering on H1
Implement a ranging market filter (such as ADX or volatility indicator) to reduce trade frequency during sideways conditions
Introduce dynamic position sizing that adjusts stop loss distance and lot size based on ATR

risk_points: 单一指标判断趋势方向，在震荡市中可能连续止损
移动止损参数设置不当可能导致过早被扫出或无法有效保护利润
缺乏最大回撤控制或单日最大亏损限制
risk_points_en: Single indicator for trend direction may lead to consecutive stop losses in ranging markets
Improper trailing stop parameter settings can cause premature exits or ineffective profit protection
Lacks maximum drawdown control or daily loss limit mechanisms

summary_en: Exp_AFStar is an Expert Advisor that implements a trend-following strategy using the AFStar signal system. It identifies trend direction through its proprietary indicator logic and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels while applying trailing stop functionality to protect gains.
